notes_meta.headline: Meta, Tesla, IBM and Lam all report today after the close. IBM goes in on a breakout, while Meta and Lam sit on their 20-day lows, Arm broke below its 200-day, and Intel is the most oversold name on the list
notes_meta.calendar: Week calendar. Wed Oct 21: Meta (1:30pm PT call), Tesla, IBM (5pm ET) and Lam Research (2pm PT / 5pm ET), all after the close, plus Micron's technology webinar (10am ET). Fri Oct 23: iPhone Duo on sale. Tue Oct 27: SoFi (about 7am ET) and Robinhood (5pm ET). Wed Oct 28: Fed decision, Microsoft (confirmed), Alphabet (est.) and Apple's "Pro and Tell" event. Thu Oct 29: Amazon, Intel and Sandisk. Mon Nov 2: Palantir (confirmed), Apple (est.). Tue Nov 3: AMD and Astera. Wed Nov 4: Arm (confirmed), Qualcomm. Thu Nov 5: MP Materials. Pending, no date: Judge Noreika's ruling on Qualcomm's five-year royalty withholding from Arm. Chart picture: a quiet, mixed day after Monday's bounce. IBM (+2.3%) broke out above its 20-day high, and AMZN held Monday's jump at its 20-day high. ARM (−3.1%) closed below its 200-day for the first time in the data, and LRCX (−3.2%) and META (−1.6%, a fifth straight loss) closed on their prior 20-day lows. INTC (RSI 11), ARM (21), SNDK (22), LRCX (23), MP (26) and ALAB (28) are the most oversold. IBM (76) is the only name above 70. Gaps: most articles could not be opened, so items are headline only. The QCOM–ARM closing-argument coverage was not found. IBKR closes match the news pages for all names except SOFI ($14.68 vs $14.69) and IBIT ($46.71 vs $46.70), each one cent off.
